evidence.quote: Unfortunately, there's no exact match with 24MP resolution, SD card storage, and higher zoom available.

observed_facts: The product details tool output in step 11 included item 9228757377 with 30MP resolution, 10x zoom, and SD card storage.
In step 12, the agent claimed there was no available camera with SD card storage and higher zoom, missing the 10x zoom option with SD card.
The agent transferred the user to a human in step 14 instead of processing the exchange.
inference: The agent misread or filtered out the available variant with 10x zoom and SD card storage due to the resolution change (30MP vs 24MP), even though the user's primary requirement was maximum zoom while keeping other specs as close as possible or specifically missing the SD card variant entirely.
needs_verification: Whether the policy allows changing resolution when exchanging items or if item 9228757377 fully satisfies the user request.
parsed.summary: The agent failed because it misread the product tool output and incorrectly told the user that no SD card variant with higher zoom existed.
